caption: The drawing features a pair of vertically oriented cylindrical objects with slightly flared tops standing side by side on a round, stepped base. The cylinders are parallel and close together, each featuring a narrow horizontal band midway between the top and base, resembling a joint or decorative ring. The objects and base are rendered in shades of gray using pencil or graphite, giving a metallic or stone-like appearance with subtle shading to indicate light and shadow. The background is plain and beige, with no additional elements or decorations. The artist's name, "Mary Fitzgerald," appears lightly in the lower right corner of the paper.
title: Candlestick Double
